evidence.text:
Our roots took hold in the heart of Texas during a time when the industry's potential had yet to fully bloom. Now, over a half century later, Willow Bridge and our 6,000+ team members have grown to be one of the largest multifamily managers in the United States, with over 240,000 units under management. Plus, we’re one of the nation’s largest multifamily developers, developing over 200,000+ units over the years, with more communities on the horizon.

Founded in 1965 in Dallas, TX - Willow Bridge (formerly Lincoln Property Company’s residential division) has seen it all when it comes to residential real estate. Throughout the decades, Willow Bridge has developed over 200,000 units and today manages 200,000 units and has $3B in investment AUM.

Following Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan’s purchase of the residential division of the company, we unveil a new name and brand. Today, Willow Bridge manages over 180,000 apartment units and eyes even more growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding marketplace. With $3B in investments under management and over $1B currently under development, the sky is the limit.

Lincoln Property Company’s residential division appears on the inaugural NMHC Top 50 list as the second largest multifamily manager with 80,706 units under management and the fourth largest multifamily developer with 63,206 units owned in 1990.

LINCOLN PROPERTY COMPANY REACHES 100,000 UNITS UNDER MANAGEMENT

With a legacy spanning decades, our purposeful journey continues. Since our inception in 1965, Willow Bridge (previously known as Lincoln Property Company’s residential division) has been led and operated by visionaries who have created, managed, and stewarded exceptional residential communities all across America.

Lincoln’s residential division launched a $1.8B investment fund with Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (OTPP) and Investment Management Corporation of Ontario (IMCO). The focus of the fund is on the development and acquisition of high quality multifamily assets in top US markets.

sources.excerpt:
Debuted on the NMHC Top 50 Managers list at No. 42 with 38K units. In October, we acquired Phoenix-based Maverick Residential and opened the new Phoenix regional office, marking our westward expansion.

RPM Living is founded in Austin, Texas as Roscoe Property Management with just 10 units under management.

We are a highly innovative, full-service multifamily property management, investment and development company.

We are passionate about acquiring, building, and operating exceptional multifamily rental communities that build our investors’ confidence and satisfy our residents’ desires for sanctuary and home. Every day, we deliver hands-on property management service, strategic investment opportunities, and property development expertise no other professional real estate company of our size can match.

Jumped to No. 11 on the NMHC Top 50 Manager list with 81K units, the highest annual growth. In January, we acquired Dallas-based Pace Realty, expanding our verticals into student and senior living, and merged with Atlanta-based CF Real Estate Services, furthering our footprint in the Southeast and Midwest.

RPM Living’s C-suite is composed of seasoned executives who lead with decades of professional experience in multifamily property management.

Our onsite leadership maintains the highest standards of service, responsiveness, and professionalism for successful multifamily property management.

View Property The Charles The Charles, a multifamily community in Destin, FL, faced early lease-up challenges due to ongoing construction delays and non-operational amenities during its first year. To maintain resident satisfaction and protect the property’s online reputation, the Asset Living team implemented proactive communication strategies, a Virtual Leasing Concierge, and a strong lineup of community engagement initiatives. These efforts helped foster a boutique-style living experience, supported by consistent resident touchpoints and timely service delivery. With an average of 50 attendees per resident event and a sub-24-hour work order completion rate, The Charles successfully built a positive, service-driven community culture amid a difficult start. Read More Solace at Cimarron Hills​ Solace at Cimarron Hills, a garden-style multifamily community in Colorado Springs, faced early lease-up challenges due to construction delays and a highly competitive market of established properties. With key amenities like the pool and clubhouse delayed, and prospect interest at risk, Asset Living deployed a strategic mix of dynamic pricing, lifestyle-driven marketing, and proactive resident communication. These efforts accelerated lease-up, increased retention, and positioned Solace at Cimarron Hills as a premier residential destination in the local market. evidence.title: Portfolio Overview | UDR Apartment Communities
evidence.text:
UDR’s portfolio strategy is driven by a commitment to growth, innovation, and sustainability. By strategically investing in new developments, acquisitions, and redevelopments, the Company creates long-term value while enhancing operational efficiency. This approach integrates cutting-edge technology, market insights, and sustainable practices to deliver high-quality living experiences that drive meaningful impact for residents, investors, and communities. Developing Innovative Communities for Tomorrow

UDR designs and develops highly functional apartment communities that appeal to a variety of demographics. By utilizing in-depth market analysis, focusing on the customers’ needs, and giving careful consideration to environmental impact, UDR delivers best in class communities that enhance its portfolio and provide long-term value throughout the lifecycle of each development project.

With keen attention to market and submarket dynamics, UDR identifies apartment communities that offer the opportunity to improve property-level cash flow. UDR creates value by improving resident satisfaction and enhancing operating efficiencies. The UDR Acquisition Team has a top-tier reputation within the industry and a demonstrated track record of success.

A strategic approach to uncovering and unlocking value within well-located apartment communities across growing markets, the Redevelopment Program targets underperforming or overlooked assets with strong potential—applying capital improvements and rebranding strategies that enhance property performance, reposition assets in their markets, and drive NOI and long-term returns. Design upgrades are aligned with market demand, with a consistent focus on elevating the resident experience and ensuring operational excellence.

Redevelopment Dynamic Portfolio Strategy

sources.title: Why Choose UDR Apartments | Exceptional Living Across 21 U.S. Markets
sources.quote:
UDR is a leading multifamily REIT that delivers strong shareholder returns through innovation, disciplined capital allocation, and a commitment to valuing its employees. Recognized as a National Top Workplace, UDR fosters an innovative culture that empowers its team members to drive operational excellence, deliver outstanding value to residents and investors, and unlock their full potential. Community Impact

UDR is committed to making a positive impact in the communities we serve through our dedication to Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) principles. We support our employees by offering paid time off for volunteering, empowering them to contribute to meaningful initiatives that strengthen and sustain local communities.

Award-Winning Communities Employer of Choice

At UDR, we embrace collaboration, trust, and innovation where every individual feels welcomed, valued, proud, and empowered to do their best. We cultivate a culture of curiosity and exploration, encouraging employees to explore, grow, and thrive.

We are honored to receive national awards recognizing our commitment to our employees' growth, well-being and success. UDR Office Locations Denver Corporate Headquarters

sources.title: Portfolio Overview | UDR Apartment Communities
sources.quote:
UDR’s portfolio strategy is driven by a commitment to growth, innovation, and sustainability. By strategically investing in new developments, acquisitions, and redevelopments, the Company creates long-term value while enhancing operational efficiency. This approach integrates cutting-edge technology, market insights, and sustainable practices to deliver high-quality living experiences that drive meaningful impact for residents, investors, and communities. Developing Innovative Communities for Tomorrow

UDR designs and develops highly functional apartment communities that appeal to a variety of demographics. By utilizing in-depth market analysis, focusing on the customers’ needs, and giving careful consideration to environmental impact, UDR delivers best in class communities that enhance its portfolio and provide long-term value throughout the lifecycle of each development project.

With keen attention to market and submarket dynamics, UDR identifies apartment communities that offer the opportunity to improve property-level cash flow. UDR creates value by improving resident satisfaction and enhancing operating efficiencies. The UDR Acquisition Team has a top-tier reputation within the industry and a demonstrated track record of success.

A strategic approach to uncovering and unlocking value within well-located apartment communities across growing markets, the Redevelopment Program targets underperforming or overlooked assets with strong potential—applying capital improvements and rebranding strategies that enhance property performance, reposition assets in their markets, and drive NOI and long-term returns. Design upgrades are aligned with market demand, with a consistent focus on elevating the resident experience and ensuring operational excellence.

Redevelopment Dynamic Portfolio Strategy

sources.title: UDR Apartments | Apartment for Rent Nationwide
sources.quote:
An investment in UDR’s stock offers an opportunity to gain exposure to a diversified portfolio of high-quality, income producing apartment communities across major U.S. markets, with a management team that has a history of delivering attractive growth and dependable returns.

Not Finding what you're looking for? Discover your perfect place with our apartment search concierge The UDR Advantage

UDR offers apartment living in some of the most desirable locations across the country.

Settle into the Seattle area with modern design and natural beauty in the city and nearby communities like Bellevue close to work, trails, and the waterfront.

Embrace the Gulf Coast lifestyle with modern comfort and waterfront living in Tampa and surrounding communities near downtown, beaches, and beyond.

evidence.title: Customer Focused | Smart Home Technology for Apartment Living Residents
evidence.text:
HHHunt opened its first apartment community in 1966 in Blacksburg, VA. Today, HHHunt Apartment Living owns and manages over 8,600 apartment homes in Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Georgia and Maryland. The company is at the forefront of innovation in multifamily development and management with communities that boast superb locations, spacious apartments and luxury amenities. To learn more about HHHunt Apartment Living, visit https://www.hhhuntapartmentliving.com. If you’re looking for an exciting career opportunity, visit us at https://www.hhhunt.com/career-opportunities.com.

HHHunt’s Apartment Living division partnered with Everon, a leading security integrator, to introduce a smart home technology package in over 7,700 apartment homes across the Southeast.

The benefits of smart apartment technology extend beyond the residents. By integrating with HHHunt’s property management system, these solutions help improve community operations and everyday workflow for our team members.

Many HHHunt communities feature smart home technology, including smart locks, smart thermostats, smart home hubs, monitored alarms and mobile app controls that allow residents to manage their homes remotely. Visit the “Amenities” section of your specific community’s website to learn more about available features.

The smart home package combines smart locks, smart thermostats and smart home hubs to give residents greater control over their homes. Designed to benefit both residents and on-site teams, this technology helps simplify everyday tasks, streamline community operations and support the exceptional service residents love about HHHunt.

Today’s renters increasingly value convenience, flexibility, peace of mind and the ability to manage their homes remotely. Smart home technology helps meet these expectations while creating a more personalized living experience.

evidence.title: HHHunt Apartment Living's Commitment to Excellence
evidence.text:
At HHHunt, our commitment to excellence has a long history. It all started in 1966 when our founder, Harry H. Hunt III, saw the need for faculty and student housing at Virginia Tech in Blacksburg, Virginia. We have been building, developing and operating some of the most award-winning and celebrated apartment home communities across the southeast ever since. Our success has stemmed from Harry’s core belief that everyone's ideas matter. Whether that idea comes from a long-term employee or a resident of one of our apartment home communities, feedback and new ideas on how to improve are the heartbeat that drives us forward. That is because we are trying to do more than just provide an apartment home. Our goal is to "To improve the world and how people live by creating meaningful experiences and places of great distinction."

"At two months in, the management and maintenance staff here have vastly exceeded my expectations. Communication is clear. Fixes are timely. The mental load this place takes off my shoulders is beyond worth the cost." -Mikey, Resident, Abberly Market Point

HHHunt Apartment Living's Commitment to Excellence

People are at the heart of every decision we make. Whether it be an apartment home, a new home, or a planned community, where we choose to live is a very significant and personal decision. That is why we strive every day to create a culture centered around customer service. Every single team member within the HHHunt Apartment Living family undergoes training through our in-house training program called HHHunt University. Overseen by our Director of Training and Development, Gabrielle Bouknight, HHHunt University includes thousands of online and in-person classes. These classes help our team think proactively about ways to improve our residents' apartment living experience and grow professionally.

evidence.title: HHHunt Apartment Living's Commitment to Excellence
evidence.text:
Unlike most apartment living companies, HHHunt has always believed in professional development. We continue to invest heavily in every employee because this translates directly to a better experience for our residents. We also invest heavily in soliciting and engaging with residents for their feedback. Using J Turner Research, a multifamily customer insights platform, we proactively reach out to our residents several times a year to see how we can continue to improve.

"I love this place and the great positive energy. There's an amazing young woman in the leasing office, and she helps me with all my packages when they come in. She is full of joy, very nice and always has an uplifting spirit. Glad to have her here." – Resident, Abberly Woods

In addition to customer service, living in an HHHunt Apartment Living community also means creating amazing experiences for our residents. Whether that be helping with the move-in process or assisting with recommendations as you navigate a new city, we want you to have an incredible experience as a resident and will do everything possible to make that a reality. One of the ways we do this is through resident engagement experiences like parties, events, contests, and community service efforts. Our apartment home communities are exactly that – a community where residents can build life-long friendships with one another and engage in meaningful ways. For example, every year, our apartment living communities participate in an annual food drive around the holidays. These food drives benefit local food pantries and provide the perfect opportunity to help others locally. Other events include trivia nights, food truck courts, paint and sip evenings, and holiday-inspired, family-friendly activities like pumpkin carving competitions and pool parties.

We are always looking for new ways to help enhance residents' experiences. From touring our communities virtually to creating a seamless move-out process with our Smooth Move program, we always take our residents' feedback to heart and create new ways to make your time with HHHunt Apartment Living as stress-free as possible.

sources.title: HHHunt Apartment Living's Commitment to Excellence
sources.excerpt:
At HHHunt, our commitment to excellence has a long history. It all started in 1966 when our founder, Harry H. Hunt III, saw the need for faculty and student housing at Virginia Tech in Blacksburg, Virginia. We have been building, developing and operating some of the most award-winning and celebrated apartment home communities across the southeast ever since. Our success has stemmed from Harry’s core belief that everyone's ideas matter. Whether that idea comes from a long-term employee or a resident of one of our apartment home communities, feedback and new ideas on how to improve are the heartbeat that drives us forward. That is because we are trying to do more than just provide an apartment home. Our goal is to "To improve the world and how people live by creating meaningful experiences and places of great distinction."

"At two months in, the management and maintenance staff here have vastly exceeded my expectations. Communication is clear. Fixes are timely. The mental load this place takes off my shoulders is beyond worth the cost." -Mikey, Resident, Abberly Market Point

HHHunt Apartment Living's Commitment to Excellence

People are at the heart of every decision we make. Whether it be an apartment home, a new home, or a planned community, where we choose to live is a very significant and personal decision. That is why we strive every day to create a culture centered around customer service. Every single team member within the HHHunt Apartment Living family undergoes training through our in-house training program called HHHunt University. Overseen by our Director of Training and Development, Gabrielle Bouknight, HHHunt University includes thousands of online and in-person classes. These classes help our team think proactively about ways to improve our residents' apartment living experience and grow professionally.

Unlike most apartment living companies, HHHunt has always believed in professional development. We continue to invest heavily in every employee because this translates directly to a better experience for our residents. We also invest heavily in soliciting and engaging with residents for their feedback. Using J Turner Research, a multifamily customer insights platform, we proactively reach out to our residents several times a year to see how we can continue to improve.

"I love this place and the great positive energy. There's an amazing young woman in the leasing office, and she helps me with all my packages when they come in. She is full of joy, very nice and always has an uplifting spirit. Glad to have her here." – Resident, Abberly Woods

In addition to customer service, living in an HHHunt Apartment Living community also means creating amazing experiences for our residents. Whether that be helping with the move-in process or assisting with recommendations as you navigate a new city, we want you to have an incredible experience as a resident and will do everything possible to make that a reality. One of the ways we do this is through resident engagement experiences like parties, events, contests, and community service efforts. Our apartment home communities are exactly that – a community where residents can build life-long friendships with one another and engage in meaningful ways. For example, every year, our apartment living communities participate in an annual food drive around the holidays. These food drives benefit local food pantries and provide the perfect opportunity to help others locally. Other events include trivia nights, food truck courts, paint and sip evenings, and holiday-inspired, family-friendly activities like pumpkin carving competitions and pool parties.

We are always looking for new ways to help enhance residents' experiences. From touring our communities virtually to creating a seamless move-out process with our Smooth Move program, we always take our residents' feedback to heart and create new ways to make your time with HHHunt Apartment Living as stress-free as possible.

HHHunt opened its first apartment community in 1966 in Blacksburg, VA. Today, HHHunt Apartment Living owns and manages over 8,600 apartment homes in Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Georgia and Maryland. If you’re looking for an exciting career opportunity, visit us at https://www.hhhunt.com/career-opportunities.com.

HHHunt’s Apartment Living division partnered with Everon, a leading security integrator, to introduce a smart home technology package in over 7,700 apartment homes across the Southeast.

The benefits of smart apartment technology extend beyond the residents. By integrating with HHHunt’s property management system, these solutions help improve community operations and everyday workflow for our team members.

Many HHHunt communities feature smart home technology, including smart locks, smart thermostats, smart home hubs, monitored alarms and mobile app controls that allow residents to manage their homes remotely. Visit the “Amenities” section of your specific community’s website to learn more about available features.

The smart home package combines smart locks, smart thermostats and smart home hubs to give residents greater control over their homes. Designed to benefit both residents and on-site teams, this technology helps simplify everyday tasks, streamline community operations and support the exceptional service residents love about HHHunt.

Today’s renters increasingly value convenience, flexibility, peace of mind and the ability to manage their homes remotely. Smart home technology helps meet these expectations while creating a more personalized living experience.

Who We Are |&nbsp Newsroom |&nbsp S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. Ranked No. 34 Among the Nation’s Top Multifamily Property Management Companies

S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. Ranked No. 34 Among the Nation’s Top Multifamily Property Management Companies

NORFOLK, VA (August 2026) – S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. is proud to announce that it has been ranked No. 34 nationally in Multi-Housing News’ 2026 ranking of the Top Multifamily Property Management Companies, placing the firm among the largest and most respected multifamily management organizations in the United States. The annual ranking recognizes the country’s leading property management companies based on a range of factors, including units under management, portfolio performance, growth, and market presence.

“The steady growth of our portfolio is due largely to the loyalty and trust of our many long-term clients, as well as our extraordinary corporate, regional, and onsite employees,” said Steve Boyce, Senior Vice President/Co-Director of Operations.

S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. Ranked No. 34 Among the Nation’s Top Multifamily Property Management Companies

NORFOLK, VA (August 2026) – S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. is proud to announce that it has been ranked No. 34 nationally in Multi-Housing News’ 2026 ranking of the Top Multifamily Property Management Companies, placing the firm among the largest and most respected multifamily management organizations in the United States. The annual ranking recognizes the country’s leading property management companies based on a range of factors, including units under management, portfolio performance, growth, and market presence.

“The steady growth of our portfolio is due largely to the loyalty and trust of our many long-term clients, as well as our extraordinary corporate, regional, and onsite employees,” said Steve Boyce, Senior Vice President/Co-Director of Operations.

Published by Multi-Housing News, the 2026 ranking evaluated 65 of the nation’s leading multifamily management firms. Collectively, these companies manage more than 4.1 million apartment units across approximately 18,800 communities nationwide, demonstrating the scale and competitiveness of the industry’s top performers.

“Being named among the top multifamily property management companies in the nation is a tremendous honor and a reflection of the dedication of our associates across every market we serve,” said Aaron Wyatt, Senior Vice President/Co-Director of Operations. “For more than a century, our company has remained committed to delivering outstanding service, fostering vibrant communities, and helping our clients achieve their investment goals. This recognition underscores the strength of our team and the trust our residents and ownership partners place in us every day.”

As the multifamily industry continues to evolve, S.L. Nusbaum Realty Co. remains committed to leveraging innovation, operational expertise, and personalized service to deliver best-in-class management solutions and strengthen the communities it serves.

sources.title: About Nestwell Property Management - Nestwell
sources.quote:
With more than 40 years of combined real estate and property management experience, our team provides full-service property management solutions designed to reduce stress, minimize vacancies, and improve long-term property performance throughout Utah. From single-family homes and condos to multi-unit rental properties, we manage every aspect of the rental process with a focus on transparency, responsiveness, and local market expertise. Whether you own one rental home or a growing investment portfolio, our goal is simple: help you maximize your property’s potential while we handle the day-to-day management.

Property Management Property Evaluations Property Accounting Property Marketing Residents Screening Rental Leasing Rental Maintenance

Owners Nestwell Pricing Owner’s Portal Our Services Guarantees Owner ROI Calculator Rent Pricing Calculator Lease Renewal Comparison Free Rental Analysis Owner Facts and Handbook

At Nestwell Property Management, we help Utah property owners simplify rental ownership, protect their investments, and create better experiences for both owners and residents.

Managing rental properties in Utah requires more than collecting rent and coordinating repairs. It requires a deep understanding of local rental markets, tenant expectations, property maintenance, leasing strategies, and Utah landlord-tenant regulations. We combine local market knowledge with proven systems to help owners:

Real estate investing is one of the most effective ways to build long-term wealth, but successful rental ownership requires time, systems, and local expertise. Our team helps Utah property investors make informed decisions with: Property performance evaluations Pricing recommendations Rental market insights Leasing strategies Maintenance planning Resident retention support

We work to help owners stay competitive in Utah’s evolving rental market while protecting the value of their investments.

Our mission is to provide dependable, professional property management services that help Utah property owners succeed while creating positive rental experiences for residents. We are committed to delivering service-driven management solutions built on integrity, communication, and long-term value.

evidence.title: Homes for Rent in North Carolina / Acorn & Oak
evidence.text:
My wife and I moved to the area and decided to rent from Acorn and Oak Property Management because of the good reviews online. They did not disappoint. Whenever we had any trouble with our rental property, Acorn and Oak always sent someone out promptly to check out the problem. The portal is very easy to use the the staff are great to interact with (we worked with Laurie and Nicole and they were super). I would highly recommend choosing to rent from Acorn and Oak.

Acorn + Oak managed our rental property while we lived out-of-state. We had an excellent experience with them. We were kept informed of issues (e.g., leaky washer, new renter applications, etc.), but always had faith that everything was professionally and efficiently handled. They also have a user-friendly online portal where you can access monthly reports, tax documents, etc. We worked with Daniel Woodward, and he was phenomenal--quick, transparent communication and always on top of it. We cannot say enough good things about working with Acorn + Oak if you are looking to rent property!

Click here to set up a call to learn more about our property management services!

SERVICES MANAGEMENT SERVICES POTENTIAL OWNER FAQs

PAY RENT PROPERTY MANAGEMENT DONE RIGHT.

The acorn and the oak have long been symbols of growth, strength, and prosperity. Legend has it that an oak branch or acorn placed inside a living space helps protect the home and its occupants. It is in this spirit that Acorn + Oak Property Management planted our own roots in North Carolina in 2013. Today we manage a growing roster of single-family homes and small multi-unit complexes throughout Durham, Raleigh, Chapel Hill and the surrounding cities.

We had reached out to a few different property management companies before our friends helped us find Acorn + Oak. When you are renting your home you want it to be in good hands and with people who make you feel heard. Ariel from Acorn + Oak listened and respected what was important to us--never pressuring us into anything and always valuing our opinion. They have been great at communicating, getting the home ready quickly, finding multiple quotes, and so impressively always one step ahead and on top of everything. Very grateful to be working with this company!

Your personal property manager and leasing expert will handle everything for you. 2. We Handle the Details

From leasing to maintenance, we manage it all—so you can stay informed without the hassle. 3. Enjoy Stress-Free Income

As a kid, I often fell asleep at night to the sound of my mother typing away at the computer. She was a successful real estate agent, and also self-managed dozens of rental properties. Carrying that load meant working very long hours for her.

Years later, I found myself managing my own rental portfolio in Denver just like what had been modeled for me. One night I was at a movie with my wife, except she was watching the movie alone while I was outside the theatre on my phone dealing with an electrical issue at one of my rentals. I knew there had to be a better way.

Tired of chasing rent, handling repairs, and navigating legal headaches? We take care of it all—with a proactive, hospitality-driven approach that keeps both owners and tenants happy.

Brandon Scholten was born and raised in Longmont, CO. Brandon was exposed to real estate and property management at a young age while his mom, Bets, was a top agent at Coldwell Banker and also self-managed a portfolio of over 50 rental units. Read More

His first hands-on experience in property management was in high school when during the Summer, he’d help with maintenance at those properties. draft_facts.text:
Many Richmond area property managers keep rents flat in an effort to avoid turning over tenants and ensure tenant retention, oftentimes to the detriment of you, the owner. Pricing a rental property under market value can cost an owner significantly in the long run. At Real Property Management Richmond Metro, we are competitive with our pricing structure and offer quarterly rental analysis to ensure your property receives the highest and best returns possible.

Likewise, Real Property Management Richmond Metro has a 10-day vacancy policy. Our company WILL NOT hold a property vacant for more than 10 days. Finding the right tenant at the right TIME can save owners hundreds of dollars in lost rents each year. Our policies and procedures ensure that your rental property will be marketed in an opportune manner, maximizing your return.

About Real Property Management Richmond Metro

Real Property Management – Richmond Metro will be your first and last stop when seeking professional property management services in Central Virginia. We service properties located in the City of Richmond, Henrico, and Chesterfield Counties. Our expertise is in multi-unit buildings in the Historic Fan and Museum Districts. Older buildings require more time and attention and our staff is well experienced in handling these historic properties! Local knowledge of the Richmond real estate market combined with the national expertise and 30 years of experience truly sets Real Property Management Richmond Metro apart from the competition.

As a real estate service provider, we are attuned to the needs of our various clients and customers. Accidental landlords, small and large investors, realtors, and tenants all trust Real Property Management. You should too! Please call or email us to find out more about our services and our current offerings.

Real Property Management is the trusted leader in reliable single-family and small multi-family residences. With over 30 years of experience and 250 plus offices nationwide, local expertise and a highly-trained responsive team, Real Property Management manages tens of thousands of properties for individuals, investors and institutions throughout the country.

Real Property Management is the local expert.

© 2026 Neighborly Company and its affiliates.

Real Property Management’s professional services include ongoing communication, comprehensive marketing, and advertising, thorough tenant screening and selection, full-service leasing, timely rent collection, regular property reviews, cost-effective and reliable maintenance, strict and compliant evictions, and comprehensive accounting.

Real Property Management makes every effort to keep you informed about your property. A secure online account provided by our team keeps you updated on property activity, including vacancies, leasing, maintenance, property reviews and financial reports. Whether you live a few blocks from your rental property or hundreds of miles away, you can monitor the activity of your property from the convenience of your computer, 24 hours a day anywhere in the world.

Each day that your property is vacant is money out of your pocket. Professional management costs are easily offset by shorter vacancy times. We spend thousands of dollars every month advertising our vacancies to get them filled – faster. Your property is advertised on high-traffic rental and classified websites. A professional “For Rent” yard sign adds exposure to capture drive-by prospective tenants. Our experienced leasing agents respond promptly to inquiries and advise prospective tenants on details about the property, and show your home in the best possible light.

Placing the wrong tenant can quickly cost you what you may save by managing a property yourself. Every tenant application is evaluated based on credit, background, employment verification and residency/rental history. Our thorough screening complies with all applicable laws, including Fair Housing and Fair Credit Reporting Act.

Your leasing agent manages the lease signing with the approved tenant, using our professionally prepared lease, and ensures that all proper contracts are executed correctly. At the same time, rents, deposits and any fees are collected in accordance with local legal and financial regulations, and recorded to your online account. We also provide professional tenant education at lease signing.

Maintenance is a necessary expense in owning a rental property, and the return on your investment can be significantly impacted without timely, cost-effective repairs and upkeep. When handled by us, you’ll save time and money and ensure repairs are completed in a professional manner, by trustworthy maintenance personnel.

Our goal is to maximize your income and minimize your expenses. To keep track of your income and expenses we use a centralized accounting system. This all-inclusive accounting and reporting system, backed with itemized statements and tax documentation, keeps all your property management financial information organized in one place.

Real Property Management Richmond Metro provides each property owner client a password-protected online account for easy access to financial reports any time you need.

Real Property Management Richmond Metro will help you protect your investment, provide comprehensive professional service, minimize your costs and maximize your income. We are 100% focused on providing quality residential property management service to property owners and residents.

Real Property Management Richmond Metro is the affordable solution to managing real estate in Henrico, VA, and the surrounding areas. We are 100% focused on quality residential property management to better serve our customers and clients. With over 30 years of brand experience, we provide industry-leading management services priced to fit any budget.

Wealth Optimizer is an intuitive, powerful interface that provides easy access to important metrics. You can compare multiple properties to quickly determine which property is right for your portfolio. The tool automatically pulls publicly available data on property valuation or specifies the valuation yourself. You can quickly change various financial assumptions, such as interest rates, holding periods, or equity, that generate comparative reports to see the impact on your property's return. You can determine appreciation, cash flow, debt reduction, combined ROI, and other financial key performance indicators.

Wealth Optimizer is backed by Real Property Management's 35 years of experience and why our customers trust us to manage more than $16 billion in rental property assets.

Using the right property management company can make you more money, not less. For more than 35 years, thousands of rental property owners and investors across the country have trusted Real Property Management offices to take care of their rental assets.

Our approach is simple. Real Property Management Richmond Metro offices provide professional, trustworthy property management services, from tenant screening to leasing to maintenance to evictions. Whether you are an investor with multiple rental properties or have a single rental, your Real Property Management Richmond Metro office has services and solutions to set you up for success.

Support is available to you around the clock, whether you need after-hours maintenance, have leasing questions, or showing requests. Our online tenant and owner portals provide access to financial statements, leases, maintenance requests, and other important information about your rental property.

evidence.text:
Using HappyCo’s integrated suite of centralized maintenance solutions and services, Blanton Turner has cut unit turns from 12-14 days to 5.7 on average, with each technician now managing 150-175 units. These gains – echoed by customers like Anchor NW Property Group – break through industry benchmarks, with other operators seeing up to 60% after-hour call deflection.

What results have multifamily operators achieved using HappyCo's AI-powered maintenance platform? Operators using HappyCo's integrated maintenance solutions have achieved measurable results including: unit turn times reduced from 12-14 days to 5.7 days average (Blanton Turner), technicians managing 150-175 units each (up from industry average), and up to 60% after-hour call deflection across customer portfolios.

Serving over 50,000 multifamily property leaders across 5.5 million units, HappyCo integrates with major property management systems, including Yardi, MRI Software, RealPage, Entrata, and ResMan. Its open API marketplace enables single-click access to a growing network of prop-tech partners.

FrOM THE Newsroom HappyCo Brings Voice-Powered Field Intelligence to Multifamily Maintenance Operations Learn More

San Diego HappyCo Brings Voice-Powered Field Intelligence to Multifamily Maintenance Operations

San Diego CA – November 13, 2025 – HappyCo, a leading provider of maintenance operations software for the multifamily real estate sector, today debuted Voice Assist – AI-powered voice capture that transforms field observations into automated workflows and predictive intelligence.‍

“Maintenance data doesn’t stop at the work order,” said Dan Regan, Director of Integrated Operations at Mark-Taylor Residential. “Completion notes are critical for us to assess service quality and identify whether issues stem from technician performance or equipment failure. That visibility drives our preventive maintenance strategy. HappyCo captures consistent documentation that reveals patterns for smarter capital planning.”
